assessment_summary: Step 0005 asserts an equation where the left-hand side is $a^{p(p-1)-1}$, but the right-hand side evaluates to $(a^{p-1})^p - 1 = a^{p(p-1)} - 1$. Since $a^{p(p-1)-1} \neq a^{p(p-1)} - 1$ for any integer $a$, the equation is mathematically false. (This appears to be a typographical error for $a^{p(p-1)} - 1$, which is also repeated in step 0011. Additionally, step 0015 later contains logical errors by incorrectly identifying (7,5), (17,3), and (32,5) as counterexamples).
